messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend** holidays that Canadians can expect in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break from Friday to Sunday or Friday to Monday.)

| Date range | Holiday | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, British Columbia) | 3‑day weekend (Fri–Mon). In Quebec it’s on Feb 13, so no long weekend there. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun). Observed in most provinces. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | 3‑day weekend (Fri–Mon). Federal holiday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | 3‑day weekend (Fri–Mon). Always on the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | 3‑day weekend (Fri–Mon). Always on the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day | 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun). Observed in many provinces. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | 3‑day weekend (Fri–Mon). |

**Other holidays that don’t create a long weekend in 2023**

| Holiday | Date | Why it isn’t a long weekend |
|---------|------|-----------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Falls on a weekend. |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Falls on a weekend. |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Falls on a weekday; no adjacent weekend. |

> **Tip for your app:** If you want to support all provinces, remember that holidays like Family Day and Remembrance Day vary by region. You can store a mapping of holiday → province(s) and then generate the long‑weekend list per user location.
